_about: Region 8 (cases 71–80, the north). New image descriptions for every person, place and object exhibit that had none. Apply with  npm run images:briefs -- prompts/briefs/region-08.json .

people.p_godana: Kenyan man, mid 50s, a white kofia and a checked shirt under a jacket, a tally book and a pen, a trimmed grey beard, exact, ID-photo framing
people.p_safiya: Kenyan woman, early 60s, a dark headscarf wrapped loosely, a printed dirac dress, a sharp listening face, ID-photo framing
people.p_wario: Kenyan man, mid 20s, a padded boda jacket, a scarf wrapped round his neck, a helmet, easygoing, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_stick: a heavy hardwood herding stick with a split in the grip, lying on swept sand in a compound, close-up
evidence.ev_gate: a corrugated iron compound gate bolted from inside, and beyond a back door to a lane with a spring latch, soft sand at the threshold
evidence.ev_wall: the top of a compound wall set with broken glass, the dust along it undisturbed, morning light, close-up
evidence.ev_bowls: two metal dog bowls of ugali and meat scraps, barely touched, in a corner of a sandy compound, a dog chain lying slack beside them, close-up
evidence.ev_house: an open sitting-room drawer holding a thick bundle of banknotes, untouched, close-up
evidence.ev_tank: the clean concrete base of a black plastic water tank in a sandy compound, no marks on it, close-up
evidence.ev_shawl: a purple shawl hanging freshly washed on a washing line in bright morning light, close-up

people.p_akuwom: Kenyan man, late 50s, a faded cap, a sweater over a vest against the wind, a thick register under his arm, stern, ID-photo framing
people.p_bar: Kenyan woman, about 50, a bright headscarf, a beaded necklace, a bar towel over one shoulder, worldly, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_boat: inside a wooden fishing boat on a beach, nets folded dry under the thwart with no weed or scales, two oars lying unmarked along the bottom

ev_sand.brief: a lake beach at dawn after a windy night, sand drifted against every boat and post, except the windward side of one capsized boat, which is bare

evidence.ev_store: the inside of a fish store, a rack of wooden fish clubs on the wall with one gap, a swept earth floor with a fresh layer of sand scattered over one damp dark patch
evidence.ev_cashbox: a locked metal cash box on a table beside a closed account book in a small co-op office, close-up

noPhoto.ev_crust: This exhibit is about the dead man's skin and clothes: no photo of a body.

people.p_nolari: Kenyan woman, early 50s, layered beaded necklaces, a cloth wrapped over her shoulders, a notebook, quietly certain, ID-photo framing
people.p_saitoti: Kenyan boy, about 11, a herd boy's red checked shuka over a T-shirt, a thin stick in his hand, serious and shy, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_hearth: a cold hearth of three stones outside a small house at dusk, a bundle of firewood untied beside it and not used, close-up
evidence.ev_goats: a goat pen of thorn branches at dawn, mother goats with their kids beside them, empty clean milk gourds hanging on a post
evidence.ev_pickup: the front-left tyre of a pickup worn bald on its inner edge, pale river sand packed in the tread, close-up

people.p_darmi: Kenyan woman, about 60, a dark patterned headscarf, a shawl, tired eyes after a night of nursing, grieving, ID-photo framing
people.p_hawo: Kenyan woman, late 40s, a bright headscarf, a printed dress, a tally book held in both hands, formidable, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_door: a steel office door with an old padlock on its hasp, hasp and frame undamaged, dust on the hinges, close-up

people.p_kioko: Kenyan man, late 40s, a plain police-style jumper and cap with no insignia, a checkpoint logbook, a weathered careful face, ID-photo framing
people.p_wife: Kenyan woman, about 50, a headscarf, a warm shawl, a phone held tight, waiting and afraid, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_brakes: the open cab of a red lorry, the handbrake lever down and the gear lever in neutral, a mechanic's torch lighting the brake fluid reservoir under the dash, close-up

ev_road.brief: a sharp bend on a mountain road at dawn, clean tarmac running to the edge with no skid marks and no ploughed gravel, a 40-metre drop beyond

people.p_chair: Kenyan man, mid 40s, a padded boda jacket over a shirt and tie, a fat file under his arm, a chairman's self-importance, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_strap_gone: the empty steel luggage rack of a parked boda motorbike, no rubber strap on it, close-up
evidence.ev_den_prints: a police ten-print fingerprint card on a desk, ten inked fingerprints in rows, an ink pad beside it, the name box out of focus

evidence.ev_dig: the rear wheel of a white 4x4 sunk to its axle in soft white desert sand, no digging and no branches under it, sand ladders still strapped to the roof rack above
evidence.ev_room: a small guest-house room, a bed made up tight with two bare pillows with no cases, a suitcase pushed under the bed, close-up

evidence.ev_lamp: a paraffin lamp lying on its side on a scorched floor, the tank cap off and the tank empty, the wick unburned, close-up
evidence.ev_tin: an old biscuit tin with its lid off lying empty under a bed, close-up
evidence.ev_bedroom: a bedroom table with a man's wallet and a closed laptop on it, untouched, close-up
evidence.ev_paddle_gone: a kitchen wall with two hooks for long wooden porridge paddles, one paddle hanging, one hook empty, close-up

people.p_nurse2: Kenyan woman, early 40s, a white nurse's tunic, a headscarf, a stack of observation charts held to her chest, tired, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_floor: clean water pooled on a laboratory annex floor, an empty yellow jerrycan lying beside it with its cap off, close-up
evidence.ev_side_door: the side door of a laboratory annex standing ajar, its lock undamaged, a key-hole lit by the corridor light, close-up
evidence.ev_crash: a family pickup crumpled against a roadside pole at night, the cab door open, brown beer bottles visible on the floor of the cab
evidence.ev_mahat_prints: a police ten-print fingerprint card on a desk, ten inked fingerprints in their boxes, an ink roller beside it, the name box out of focus

people.p_mother: Kenyan woman, late 50s, a dark headscarf, a printed dirac dress, a photograph of her daughter held face-down, frightened, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_emo_prints: a police ten-print fingerprint card on a desk, ten inked fingerprints in rows, an ink pad beside it, the name box out of focus
